**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

- **Supply side (Article IX)** — nothing locks us into Array as sole source. §9.4(a) (p0508) expressly gives Ono "the right (but not the obligation)" to Manufacture or engage its own Subcontractor, backed by a Know-How transfer and personnel support (a genuine second-source/step-in right); §9.4(b) (p0509) is a right to obtain commercial requirements from Array, triggered only "Upon Ono's request"; §9.1(a) (p0495) binds Array to supply without any reciprocal requirements commitment from us; §9.5 (p0516) passes Array's Third Party supplier benefits through to us. This meets the preferred position.
- **§8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts (p0491)** — the only exclusivity binding us, but it is a reciprocal field non-compete, not exclusive dealing: mutual, confined to two defined Competing Product categories, confined to the Ono Territory, time-limited, and given in exchange for the exclusive licences we receive under §2.1(a)/(c). At or above the fallback.
- **Exclusivity in our favour** (p0162, p0164 licences; p0617/p0619 trademark and domain licences) deliberately not flagged.
- Noted only in the rationale: §8.2 does not expressly release us from the restriction if Array itself commercialises a Competing Product (it instead terminates the royalty period) — a minor sub-element, not a material failure.
